CLARITY Act stalls again as Senate recess approaches –
Link
The Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act was left off the Senate's Thursday schedule despite Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott saying a vote will happen before recess. Democratic leadership is reportedly pushing to delay a procedural vote.
Matters because: Continued regulatory limbo could keep institutional players cautious until US market-structure rules are clearer.

Wintermute registers as SEC/FINRA broker-dealer, eyes crypto ETF and tokenized equity market-making –
Link
Wintermute's US arm has registered as a broker-dealer under SEC and FINRA oversight. It plans to trade commodities and crypto ETFs first, then expand into tokenized equities pending approval.
• The firm is positioning for designated market-maker status on NYSE and Nasdaq.
• It aims to compete with Jump Trading, Jane Street, and Citadel Securities within 3-5 years.
Matters because: More regulated market-making infrastructure could improve liquidity and price discovery for crypto ETF produc
